title: POST /v1/sites/{id}/inventory request
description: final-fix-server-rereview.md B-1: `components` (max 500) x `locales` (max 256, unique) must not exceed 20,000 -- each list's own maxItems bounds it individually, but the SERVICE'S actual per-request work is the full cross product of the two, so the product itself is capped independently (over the limit -> 422 validation_error; not expressible as a JSON Schema keyword, enforced service-side). A real multilingual site's example fanout (200 components x 30 locales = 6,000) sits far below this.

extra_domains.description: additional text domains served by the same slug (e.g. Avada's fusion-* domains)

bundled_locales.description: locales the component already ships with its own translation files

installed.description: keyed by locale code; only locales for which this site currently has a Babilim-installed language file

locales.description: final-fix-server-rereview.md B-1: a repeated locale used to cost the service N times the per-cell work for every single component, for zero legitimate benefit -- unlike bundled_locales/extra_domains/components, where a duplicate is merely wasteful, not itself a per-cell query-count amplifier (those deliberately do NOT require uniqueItems, see docs/api/CHANGELOG.md's 1.2.0 entry).

code.description: generic error code only, e.g. integrity_failed; never string content
